source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR3 indexes conflict and provenance state but intentionally omits a dedicated read surface for service conflicts and stale claims.

## SUCCESS
knowledge_conflicts returns conflicts, stale/superseded/invalidated claim metadata, authority, citations, and service routing from the existing index.

## SCOPE
packages/service-knowledge/src/service_knowledge/mcp/knowledge_conflicts.py plus focused tests and MCP registration.

## NON_GOALS
No conflict resolution, mutation, auto-remediation, or PR3 scope expansion.

## CONSTRAINTS
Read-only; reuse sk_conflicts/sk_items and existing provenance filters; no new dependency.

## VALIDATION
Focused unit and MCP protocol tests covering active, stale, superseded, and invalidated state.

## OUTPUT
Implementation commit, tests, and docs update.

SCRUTINY: medium
